key_reasoning.reason: Touches 6+ distinct components across 4 subsystems: the agent-plugin layer (new AgentHookConfig.otlpIngestion flag in agents/core/types.ts, new cursor-ide agent plugin, registry.ts registration), the shared CLI hook pipeline (hook.ts's createHookCommand action gains the otlpIngestion bypass, stdout-response contract, and neverBlockingExit gating), the proxy CLI workflow (connect-orchestrator.ts's DaemonIdentity/EffectiveClientType extended, early-return fast path removed, new .cursor/hooks.json connector, disconnect-orchestrator wiring), and the proxy server layer (new OtlpIngestPlugin registered in plugins/index.ts). Two new shared utilities (project-root.ts, hook-command.ts's resolveCodemieBinaryFromPackage) were also introduced.

No exact precedent for a full-bypass declarative hook flag or for removing an existing target's daemon-skip fast path (a behavior change that touches the shared connectTargets flow used by every other proxy target). Red flag applied: the new /v1/otlp/hook-events route and the daemon-lifecycle change both touch authentication/authorization (OtlpIngestPlugin requires ctx.metadata.gatewayKeyValidated from gateway-key.plugin.ts, and cursor-ide now goes through the same SSO-credentialed ensureDaemon flow as every other target) — bumped Technical Risk from M to L. Mitigated by reusing the established ProxyPlugin/handleRequest and connector (writeAtomically, backup-on-first-modification) patterns.

23 files touched (15 modified, 8 new) spanning agents/core, agents/plugins/cursor-ide (new dir), agents/registry.ts, agents/__tests__, cli/commands (hook.ts, proxy/index.ts, proxy/connect-orchestrator.ts, proxy/disconnect-orchestrator.ts, proxy/connectors — new file, proxy/__tests__ x2), providers/plugins/sso/proxy/plugins (index.ts + new otlp-ingest.plugin.ts), utils (hook-command.ts, logger.ts, new project-root.ts), plus docs/ARCHITECTURE-PROXY.md, package.json, .gitignore, and plan.md — 16+ modified/new-file band, matching XXL.

4 distinct layers touched: Service/business logic (agent registry + hookConfig declarative dispatch in hook.ts), API/CLI (proxy connect/disconnect command surface, new --cursor-ide/--analytics flags), Infrastructure (proxy daemon lifecycle — DaemonIdentity extended, early-return fast path removed for cursor-ide, new server-side plugin route), and local persistence (new hook-events.jsonl append, .cursor/hooks.json write/merge) — no DB schema migration, so capped at L rather than XL.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M (3) to L (4): the new /v1/otlp/hook-events route and the cursor-ide daemon-lifecycle change both touch authentication/authorization (gateway-key validation, shared SSO-credentialed daemon spawn path).
